name: Fiji · Nadi and the islands
summary: Fiji's islands are fringed by soft coral reefs and white beaches, with famously warm hospitality. Base yourself near Nadi or Denarau, then island-hop the Mamanucas and Yasawas, snorkel with manta rays, visit a village for a kava ceremony and soak in the Sabeto mud pools.
seasonNote: May to October is dry and cooler; November to April is hot, wet and cyclone season.
arrival: Nadi International Airport; boats leave from Port Denarau.
gettingAround: Island ferries (Yasawa Flyer), seaplanes and taxis.
cashTip: Resorts take cards; carry Fijian dollars for markets, village visits and sevusevu kava gifts.
foodTip: Kokoda (raw fish in coconut) and lovo feasts.
buyTip: Tapa cloth, wood carvings and Fiji Water souvenirs.
baseArea: Denarau, the Coral Coast or an island resort
